newsitem.title: USA: Gold Capital in Globex merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Gold Capital in Globex merger talks.

text.p: Gold Capital Corp said Tuesday it is engaged in merger negotiations with Globex Mining Enterprises Inc .
In the proposed merger, Globex would acquire Gold Capital and assume management of its Tonkin Springs Project in Eureka County, Nev.
Gold Capital currently owns 60 percent of that project, which it manages under an agreement with U.S. Gold Corp, which owns the remaining 40 percent.
Successful completion of the merger would result in Globex acquiring all of Gold Capital's common shares.

Consummation of the merger is subject to a number of contingencies, including finalization of a definitive merger agreement between the parties, shareholder approval, and Globex's ability to obtain about $18 million to undertake the merger, said the company.
